name: cozyos
description: CozyOS — root manifest. Declares the playwright dependency required by server/webauthn-rp and other *-browser.test.js suites, and the pg dependency required by server/webauthn-rp/database-adapter.js's PostgreSQLDatabaseAdapter (Phase B1/B2) and the Phase B1 migration/import tooling. No other npm package is required anywhere in this repository.
